narrative.overview: The implemented interface is a light scientific workspace with restrained forest accents, pale backgrounds, dense expert forms, and persistent navigation. Serif page headings distinguish page identity while compact sans-serif controls support repeated configuration.
keyCharacteristics: Light surfaces with muted green structure
Flat panels and visible keyboard focus
dos: Do reuse forest for actions, selection, and focus.
Do preserve visible labels, hints, and textual job states.
Do keep scientific artifacts faithful to their source.
donts: Don't add shadows to ordinary panels.
Don't rely on color alone to explain job state.
Don't remove reduced-motion treatment or visible keyboard focus.
